description: Buy a Fold Semester Pass for a college student at UCLA, USC, UC Berkeley, or UCSF. The PURCHASER (often a parent) provides their own name + email for the receipt, plus the student's name + email. Returns a Stripe Checkout URL — the purchaser must visit it to complete payment. Once paid, the student gets a separate email with an activation link to fill in their dorm details. campusId, termId and pricing come from list_campuses. Pricing varies by campus and term; the response echoes the priceCents.

frequency.description: Pickup cadence. WEEKLY is the most common choice.

giftMessage.description: Optional short message displayed to the student in the activation email.

idempotencyKey.description: OPTIONAL — UUID for safe retry. Identical keys return the EXISTING pass + checkout URL instead of creating a duplicate. Recommended for production agents.

isGift.description: Default true. Set false only if the purchaser IS the student.

purchaserEmail.description: Email of the purchaser — Stripe receipt + thank-you confirmation go here

purchaserName.description: Full name of the purchaser (parent/sponsor) — appears on the receipt

studentEmail.description: Student email — .edu strongly preferred so the activation link reaches their school inbox

name: buy_semester_pass
title: Buy Semester Pass
